items.title: Tesla FSD approved in Italy, the first big EU market to say yes
items.teaser: Italy’s transport ministry has granted provisional approval to Tesla Assisted Driving, the name Tesla now uses for “Full Self-Driving (Supervised)” in Europe. Italy becomes the 12th European country to allow the system, and the first of the EU’s big markets. It also didn’t wait for Brussels. The EU committee that decides on bloc-wide recognition isn’t expected to vote until December at the earliest.

items.title: I got to tour SpaceX's Starfactory facility in Starbase, Texas, and what I saw blew my mind
items.teaser: SpaceX invited media on an unprecedented behind-the-scenes tour of its Starfactory facility, where it manufactures and assembles both stages of its massive Starship rocket.
